BiblicalUsage: ʼêlem is a plain word for silence. It stands in the heading of Psalm 56, in the phrase 'Jonath-elem-rechokim' — the dove of silence — and it turns up again in Psalm 58:1, where the psalm asks whether rulers speak righteousness at all.
TheologicalSignificance: For me, ʼêlem means silence, and I leave it at that.
